# About this prototype {.unnumbered}

This small book tests a web-primary authoring model for *Modeling and
Programming with Gecode*. The same Quarto source renders as navigable HTML
pages and as one typeset PDF. It also treats each complete C++ example as a
canonical source file that the build includes, compiles, and runs.

The prototype deliberately exercises the document features on which MPG
depends: mathematics, cross-references, citations, vector diagrams, and tested
programs. @sec-magic-sequence contains the worked example.

## Build contract

The source tree owns prose (`.qmd`), programs (`examples/*.cpp`), and diagrams
(`figures/*.dot`). Generated HTML, PDF, SVG, extracted sources, and binaries
live below `_build/` or match ignored generated figure extensions.

Run `make verify QUARTO=/path/to/quarto` to render both formats and test the
program. `README.md` in this prototype directory records the exact experiment
and its limits.
